claim: disrobe lowers a Dalvik method body (rather than a throw-stub) for the large majority of methods on real FOSS APKs.
detail: Two separate populations, stated separately. Self-reported body lowering: 82788 of 89516 defined methods across the three apks get a lowered body rather than a throw-stub, which is the lifter counting its own output (transmissionic 26192 of 27805 = 94.2, rustdesk 29376 of 32410 = 90.6, enrecipes 27220 of 29301 = 92.9). Verifier-attested: 2960 of 2994 recovered bodies presented to the real JVM pass -Xverify:all = 98.9 (transmissionic 980 of 993, rustdesk 1205 of 1216, enrecipes 775 of 785). The attested denominator is not the method count: 82756 non-stub candidate bodies, a deterministic 100-permille sample takes 8343, and 2994 of those can be re-hosted into an isolated Object carrier, so 5349 are excluded by harness limits and are ungraded rather than passing (1400 constructors, 1672 invokespecial receivers, 2128 unresolvable framework dependencies, 149 other). The apks are gitignored, so both figures are local; the committed-dex bar above is the CI-enforced attestation and its denominator is classes, not bodies.
gate_source: crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/dalvik_realworld_body_attest.rs (REAL_APK_METHOD_TOTAL 89516 and ATTESTED_PRESENTED 2994 pinned by equality, SELF_REPORTED_BODY_FLOOR 82788, ATTESTED_CLEAN_FLOOR 2960, ATTESTED_FAIL_CEILING 34, per-apk pins in common::REAL_APKS) and crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/dex2jar_realworld_apks.rs (per-apk self-reported numerator floors against equality-pinned method totals); reference for the attested figure = java -Xverify:all rejecting malformed bytecode, not the lifter self-report

oracle.external: none external: this counts methods for which the lifter returned a body vs a throw-stub (self-reported coverage, NOT verifier-attested)
oracle.note: This is a coverage number, not a correctness number. It is graded against nothing external (disrobe asserting it produced output). The verifier-attested correctness number is the dalvik-verifier descriptor. Phase 2 upgrades this to a verifier-attested or dex2jar-differential number on SHA-pinned FOSS APKs before it earns a competitor column.

reproduce: cargo test -p disrobe-pass-jvm --test dex2jar_realworld_apks (local-only: the APKs are gitignored)
title: Dalvik body-lowering coverage on real FOSS APKs
